info.title: optigraph-migrate
info.description: Scans a solution for Optimizely Search and Navigation (Find) usage and reports the Optimizely Graph migration path.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Scans a solution for Optimizely Search & Navigation (Find) usage and reports the Optimizely Graph migration path.

commands.name: scan
commands.description: Scans a solution or project for Find usage and reports the Optimizely Graph migration path.

options.name: --output
options.description: File path to write the report to. Defaults to stdout.

options.name: --format
options.description: Report format: console, sarif, json, markdown, or html.

options.name: --rules
options.description: Path to a rule catalogue file overriding/extending the built-in Find-to-Graph mappings.

options.name: --severity-threshold
options.description: Minimum severity (info, warning, error) a finding must have to be included in the report.

options.name: --fail-on
options.description: Minimum severity (info, warning, error) that causes a non-zero exit code.

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: Path to a solution (.sln/.slnx) or project file to scan.
